questions.question: She said that she would have left earlier if she hadn’t been waiting for her flight. What is the correct way to report this statement using the past perfect tense?
options: She said she would have left earlier if she had been waiting for her flight.
She said she would have left earlier if she had waited for her flight.
She said she would have left earlier if she had been waiting for her flight had been delayed.
She said she would have left earlier if she had been waiting for her flight, but she didn’t.
questions.answer: She said she would have left earlier if she had waited for her flight.
